title: Retried payment captures charge the customer twice
description: PaymentService.capturePayment generates a fresh idempotency key inside the retried operation. When the gateway processes a charge but the response times out, the retry is sent with a different key, so the gateway treats it as a new charge.
reproduction: Configure the fake gateway to lose the response of the next request (failNextResponses(1)).
Observe two charges recorded by the gateway.

failing_test.name: charges the customer exactly once when a timed-out request is retried

expected_behavior: A single logical capture produces exactly one charge, regardless of how many times the request is retried.
regression_tests: captures a payment once when the gateway responds normally
gives up after exhausting retries on persistent timeouts
records separate charges for separate capture calls
